description:
We are looking for Service Now Developer in NYC, NY for Fulltime position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job details mentioned below- 
 ​Title: Service Now Developer 
 Location: NYC, NY 
 Duration: ​Fulltime 
 Client: Direct Client 
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required Education: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent
 
 Required Experience: 
 · 3-5 years professional level work in the design, development and implementation of enterprise solutions for business applications in broad-scale, web-delivered environments, including 1+ years with the ServiceNow tool and applications (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog) and related implementation (i.e. configuration, design work, technical configuration, deployment). 
 · Must include the administration and development of a ServiceNow instance including the delegation of groups, modification of CMS, workflows, business rules, UI actions, UI policies, ACLs, dictionary, Client and Server Side Scripting, Workflow Development, Record Producer development, catalog items and updates of all other existing solutions requiring revisions. 
 · Experience with working or developing in any one of the following programming languages: JavaScript, PHP, C, Java, Perl, HTML or HTML 5. 
 · Experience in Web Services Integration (SOAP, REST, and JSON) and Web technologies (Web Services, SSO, XML, Ajax, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Jelly, Glide Scripting, AngularJS, jQuery). 
 · Experienced in the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes including Requirements Analysis, Design, Installation, Development, Testing (application code and user acceptance), and Deployment. 
 · Experience with the with agile and SDLC software development methodologies. 
 Preferred Experience: 
 Experience with ServiceNow Implementer and support at a large or a medium sized higher education or comparable institution. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities: 
 · Excellent communication, problem-solving, analytical, and multi-tasking skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office application tools (i.e., Power Point, Excel, Word, and Visio). 
 · Demonstrated ability to design, deliver, and clearly articulate technical solutions based on the ServiceNow platform that meet both business needs and established practices (including coding and development standards). 
 · Demonstrated leadership skills in technical initiatives. 
 · Ability to generate detailed documentation. 
 · Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-organizational teams, across different geographic regions, who may have varied technical skills and to share knowledge for the betterment of the team and the organization. 
 · Demonstrated ability to adapt priorities as business needs evolve. 
 · Demonstrated understanding and use of change management systems and procedures. 
 · Proven ability to manage and meet tight project deadlines. 
 
 Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Abilities: 
 ITIL certification. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
